signal.title: ⚠️ Ledger guard dead
signal.body:
⚠️ No completed ledger-guard run has been observed for over 90 minutes. The committed ledger on `main` is only refreshed by the guard between sweeps, so a dead guard leaves it stale with no red run.

Last heartbeat: 2026-11-20 14:55 UTC (status ok)
**Checked:** 2026-11-22 02:05 UTC
**Detail:** last guard heartbeat 2026-11-20 14:55 UTC (2110 min ago, status ok) — older than the 90-minute threshold; a guard run is pending (forced), but the heartbeat is older than the 420-minute maximum latency — a queued guard that never lands is a real outage

This issue is the durable signal for #128 — the guard's hourly schedule is the retry path for failed ledger publishes, so a dead guard is load-bearing (see #115). It is NOT a digest issue: the digest watch only closes digest issues, and board-sync only skips digest issues — this one stays open until a fresh heartbeat appears. The watchdog closes it automatically with a recovery comment when the guard is alive again.

WSJF: 6.0
